finding: In the frozen cohort, conditioning source-exposure rows on nonblank target tags raises Sunset's descriptive tag share from 20.418% to 45.502%. Inside the selected tagged subset, Sunset is 33.989% of actions, 45.502% of exposures and products, and 52.413% of bytes. An action-carried sensitivity remains a 51.495% byte share.
claim_ceiling: Stage 11U may establish that, in the frozen complete-action cohort, Sunset occupies 1,553 of 7,606 source-exposure tag fields (20.418%), 1,553 of 3,413 nonblank target-tag rows (45.502%), 311 of 915 actions with any nonblank tag (33.989%), and 409,399,017,151 of 781,104,206,358 bytes attached to nonblank-tagged exposures (52.413%). The same byte-majority result remains 51.495% in an action-carried sensitivity that includes blank exposures from selected actions. The byte result is representation-sensitive: Sunset is 49.188% of tagged source-representation bytes, 52.720% of tagged raw-representation bytes, and 52.734% of tagged processed-representation bytes. The result is also activity-conditioned: activity 24_Sunset supplies 1,294 of 1,553 Sunset-tagged exposures, and outside it Sunset is 12.223% of tagged exposures and 21.554% of tagged bytes. Across all 23 nonblank target-tag values, the concentration equivalent contracts from 5.064 tag values under fractional action weighting to 3.823 under exposure or product weighting and 3.191 under byte weighting. These are declared metadata-query and unit-weighting results.
